Hi Taylor — thanks for the note and for uploading the traffic matrix, that helps a lot. A few quick pre-demo questions so we can tailor the session:

2) For the peak concurrency (~30 req/s), are those short (<2s) calls or do they include multi-step chat flows with KV cache (longer-lived contexts)?
3) Is ParcelMate planning to use Redwood Hosted API or a Dedicated/Private deployment for the pilot? (affects routing/batching defaults)
4) Any compliance constraints (data residency, SOC2 evidence) we should prepare ahead of the call?

1) Split is roughly 60% embeddings (search/ranking), 40% generation (short summaries, ~30–80 tokens each).

3) Pilot: likely Redwood Hosted to start (ease of onboarding). If all goes well we may move to Dedicated for production.
4) We need SOC2 and a basic data residency statement for the pilot — US-only fine.

Wed 6/14 at 09:00 PT works for us. Adding Samir (our platform lead) on the thread — he can share a zoom link or accept the calendar invite. Sending over the traffic matrix you referenced.
